messages:
Alex: quick thought — the p95 chart looks good but the recent spike overlay (burstiness) feels visually noisy when you hover and the inline annotation pops in.
Tara: agreed, saw it during today's demo. spikes are helpful but the annotation should be less dominant. maybe fade after 3s? :hourglass: 
Mike: what if we show a subtle dot-on-sparkline + a small persistent badge in the heatmap legend rather than a full tooltip each time? keeps context but reduces popups.
Jess: +1 ondot + legend badge. also keyboard users lose the hover affordance — need focus states and aria labels.
Alex: good call. accessibility is key. @Tara can you mock a compact state: dot + 2px ring on focus + brief sr-only text?
Tara: on it. proposing CSS prototype: ```css
/* burst badge */
.burst-dot { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:#ff9f43; opacity:.9; }
.burst-dot:focus { outline: 2px solid #0033cc; outline-offset: 2px; }
.burst-legend { font-size:12px; color:#222; }
.burst-fade { transition: opacity .35s ease; opacity:.2; }
```
Mike: recommend using our color tokens (warning-400) and run contrast check. also make sure dot isn't the only indicator — add an accessible name: `aria-label=\"burst spike at 3m 12s\"`.
Jess: microcopy tweak: instead of "burst", use "short throughput spike" in the tooltip/legend — clearer for PMs.
Alex: thought: sampling controls interact with this — when sampling rate is low we should show an overlay indicator: "Sampling suppressed: potential spikes hidden" (small banner in heatmap).
Tara: love that. UX question: where to put the sampling banner so it doesn't obscure p95 card? maybe top-right corner of the panel, collapsed by default.
Mike: proposal: collapsed pill with icon and tooltip. clicking expands to quick controls (sampling slider + explainers). keyboard accessible.
Jess: accessibility nits: ensure the pill is focusable, has descriptive aria-expanded and aria-controls. Use `role=button`. Also add `aria-live=polite` when the banner appears so screen reader users know sampling changed.
DesignBot: uploaded image: https://files.redwood/mockups/burst-dot-pills.png :eyes: (preview in thread)
Alex: screenshot looks promising. Tara — can you produce a tiny prototype and we run an engineering review Fri morning? I'll add to the agenda: "p95 spike annotations + sampling banner".
Tara: will do. I'll include two variants: dot+legend and inline badge that fades after 2s. will also include keyboard flows and a11y checklist.
Mike: FYI: if we implement fade, ensure motion reduction preference respected: `prefers-reduced-motion` => disable fade.
Jess: final copy proposal for pill tooltip: "Sampling reduced — short spikes may be hidden. Click to adjust sampling or view raw traces." Shorten if needed.
Alex: perfect. And add a note for SRE: any change to sampling defaults should be telemetry gated so we can track regressions in platform metrics.
Tara: added. will link to the telemetry ticket in the mock.
Mike: :thumbsup:
Jess: :eyes: thanks team.
Alex: wrapping — next steps: Tara prototype, engineering review, accessibility pass with axe, then small canary rollout behind flag.
